## Summary

The specification asked to reject creating an owner when another owner already has the **same last name and the same telephone number**, returning **409**.

The controller already returned 409 via an `isDuplicateOwner` helper, but it required *all* fields (first name, last name, address, city, telephone) to match — too strict for this spec. I changed the duplicate check in `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`'s helper to compare only last name and telephone:

`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`
```java
private boolean isDuplicateOwner(Owner owner) {
    return this.clinicService.findOwnerByLastName(owner.getLastName()).stream()
        .anyMatch(existing ->
            Objects.equals(existing.getLastName(), owner.getLastName())
                && Objects.equals(existing.getTelephone(), owner.getTelephone()));
}
```

`findOwnerByLastName` is a prefix match, so the explicit `getLastName()` equality check keeps it to an exact last-name match. On a match, `addOwner` returns `HttpStatus.CONFLICT` (409); otherwise it saves and returns 201.

Tests: `OwnerRestControllerV1Tests` (22) pass, and the full suite (258 tests) is green.
